name: print-social-car-sharing-poster-dark-green-share-your-car-easiest-way
title: 'Share your car the easiest way with our APP' poster with an overlapping route-list card and scribble loops
whatItIs: A dark green A4 poster with mint scribble loops in the corners, a bold headline mixing solid and script type ('Share your car the easiest way with our APP'), a 'Download it for free and enjoy now!' line, and two overlapping phone-screen cards showing a route search list with avatars and green add buttons.
whatItMeans: Direct and inviting; overlapping app-screen cards suggest depth and real functionality behind a simple poster message.
techniques: Overlap two UI screenshots for a sense of layered depth.
Mix solid and script type within one headline for emphasis.
Repeat the same scribble-loop motif across a campaign's assets.

vocabulary.definition: A cropped image of an app screen used as a design element.
A recurring visual device tying together multiple assets.
